title: Miromar Lakes vs Grandezza Estero FL: What Does $630,000 Buy You in Each? 2026
excerpt: At about $630,000, Miromar Lakes and Grandezza buy similar square footage and nearly identical tax bills, but the yearly bill is built differently: Grandezza adds a mandatory social club, while Miromar Lakes stacks condo, master and CDD fees, and neither is a blanket no-flood-zone answer.
